claim_type: Bott-Chern number jump witness with Kuranishi-stratum rigidity fragment
limitations: Uses cited authorities for Gauduchon-on-surface existence, Schweitzer Bott–Chern finiteness and semicontinuity, Lin–Ye relative Bott–Chern obstruction/jump theory, the Oeljeklaus–Toma/Inoue construction, and the pluriclosed criterion.
The extendability locus is a local deformation germ; only transversality in the specified Beltrami direction and the nearby drop along that direction are proved.
The exact Bott–Chern dimension in bidegree (1,1) is not computed; only nontriviality and a drop by at least one are proved.
The argument parameter in the invariant coframe cancels; no explicit value is needed.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment completed on 2026-09-30 UTC.
record_title: Bott-Chern (1,1) jump versus rigidity on a named pluriclosed Hopf/class-VII-type solvmanifold 3-fold stratum
